## Description

The description the MCP server sends to the model, word for word. Its rules apply to every call.

> List WriteStack articles from newsletters the user has enabled in Articles, optionally filtered by status or publicationId. Call list_article_newsletters first if you need valid publication IDs. Returns title, topic, status, target date (plannedForDate, null for undated drafts), publicationId, and Substack sync fields.

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | `number` | No | Default `20`. |
| `publicationId` | `number` | No | Enabled newsletter publicationId. BEFORE creating or pushing an article, call list_article_newsletters and ASK the user which newsletter to use. Never guess or pick a default. Only IDs returned by that tool are accepted — newsletters the user hid from Articles are rejected. |
| `skip` | `number` | No | Default `0`. |
| `status` | `string` | No | One of: `"planned"`, `"generating"`, `"draft"`, `"reviewed"`, `"failed"`. |
